_about: Search grids and fixed parameters, read by the Sage scripts, tests/model.py and tests/synth_generated.py.
scripts/export_site_data.sage copies the stateless grid and the UXMSS bounds into site/data.json; docs/model.md explains the values.
stateless.budgets: the signature budgets (log2) the stateless page offers. grid is the one of grid.q_s_log2; at another budget its h range moves by the difference.
bgs_cc: the BGS-CC parameter sets of a budget ({q} in fts, a budget without the file has no BGS-CC) and the default budget; their hypertrees take d and w from the stateless grid, with w_optional.
